mask_reason: Fixed screen-space top tutorial band, hotbar, lower-right hand and central crosshair; applied before official preprocessing identically for both conditions. Removes some scene pixels too.
primary: Native cosine retrieval between routes 4 and 5 in both directions; query and gallery target headings differ by exactly 180 degrees. One gallery endpoint per site. Report all three layers, no test-based layer selection.
metrics: held-out latent-distance versus XZ distance Spearman association
secondary: Report same-heading and 90-degree retrieval separately. For geometry use distinct site pairs and stratify heading differences; do not count duplicate/reversed pairs as independent observations.
controls: repeated last frame at every layer
site-label permutation within route/heading retaining all repeats of each site together
ambiguity: Train-route pixel-MSE ranking is exploratory screening only. Report all sites in primary analysis; any ambiguity subset must be recorded using training images before test feature analysis.
supervised_followup: Train routes 0/1 only, select settings on routes 2/3 only; freeze settings before routes 4/5. No supervised fitting in extraction.
uncertainty: Report per-site and per-direction results; any bootstrap resamples sites as clusters and is conditional on this single world and fixed routes. Do not claim independent thousands of pairs or population-level route generalization.
claim_scope: Known-site cross-route/view generalization within one world; no persistent memory, grid/place cells or navigation claim. Shared final approaches and available distant landmarks are confounds.
